import asyncio


# CASE width_first_helper expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(width, items, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE width_first_call_one expect=fire
async def width_first_call_one(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(1, items, save)


# CASE op_first_call_one expect=fire
async def op_first_call_one(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(save, items, 1)
